title: Our School: A Happy Place
seo_title: Our School Class 5 EVS Worksheet with Answers (NCERT Our Wondrous World Chapter 4)
standard_code: Class 5, Our Wondrous World Chapter 4: Our School
standard_text: Making school a happy place: rules, teamwork and respect; kind and unsafe behaviour; dealing with feelings and bullying; inclusion of children with disabilities; people who help at school; safety drills for fire and earthquakes (summary of NCERT Our Wondrous World Chapter 4).
meta_desc: Free CBSE Class 5 EVS worksheets for NCERT Our Wondrous World Chapter 4: school rules, teamwork, kindness, inclusion, people who help at school, bullying and safety drills. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: A happy school is safe, fair and kind.
key_sub: Rules, teamwork and respect help everyone learn.
body_html:
How to think about it

A school is happy when everyone feels safe, welcome and respected. Rules help us learn together; teamwork helps us finish a class garden or a play; kindness means sharing, waiting for our turn and including everyone. Bullying is never acceptable: tell a trusted adult.

Inclusion means every child can take part: ramps for wheelchairs, braille and large-print books, and sign language. Many people help at school: the librarian, nurse, cook and guard. In a fire drill we walk out calmly in a line; in an earthquake we drop, cover and hold on.

Example

During an earthquake…

under a strong table

Answer: drop, cover and hold on

Example

Braille helps…

reading by touch

Answer: people who cannot see

Common mistakes

  • Running and pushing during a fire drill.
  • Keeping quiet about bullying.
  • Thinking rules are only for some students.

faq.q: What does inclusion mean at school?
faq.a: Making sure every child, including children with disabilities, can take part and feels welcome.

faq.q: What should you do in an earthquake?
faq.a: Drop to the floor, cover your head under a strong table and hold on until the shaking stops.
